name: Deal screen
what: A one-page record of the first look at a deal: the buy-box check, quick price and yield math, the public-record flags, the open questions and the decision to underwrite or pass.

fields.label: Property
fields.definition: Address, property type, and size in square feet or units, as the offering states them.

fields.label: Source
fields.definition: Who brought the deal: a listing broker, an owner contacted directly, or another source.

fields.label: Asking price or guidance
fields.definition: The seller's asking price or pricing guidance; blank if the deal is unpriced.

fields.label: Stated NOI
fields.definition: Net operating income as the offering memorandum states it, before any adjustment.

fields.label: Quick math
fields.definition: Going-in cap rate, price per square foot or unit, and the loan the income supports, each with its formula and inputs.

fields.label: Buy-box check
fields.definition: Each buy-box criterion marked pass, fail or unknown, with the fact behind the mark.

fields.label: Flood zone
fields.definition: The FEMA flood zone at the site, with the map panel and its effective date.

fields.label: Appraisal record
fields.definition: Owner of record, account number, appraised land and improvement values, tax year, and the taxing units.

fields.label: Zoning
fields.definition: The zoning district, whether the current use is allowed outright, by permit or only as nonconforming, and a link to the ordinance.

fields.label: Environmental database hits
fields.definition: Records on or next to the site from EPA and state databases, each with a link. A screen, not a Phase I.

fields.label: Open questions
fields.definition: Questions for the broker or seller before underwriting, including every figure the documents disagree on.

fields.label: Decision
fields.definition: Underwrite, ask questions first, or pass, with the reason, the person who decided and the date.
